# Ihthos

> Ihthos is a small studio that builds practical AI automation, workflow integrations, and custom business software for small businesses, with human review kept where decisions matter.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ihthos.com/): What Ihthos does and how it approaches AI automation and custom software.
- [Services](https://ihthos.com/services/): Workflow assessment, AI automation, system integrations, lead and customer operations, and custom software.
- [How it works](https://ihthos.com/process/): The project process, from understanding a process through scope, build, review, and handoff.
- [Boundaries](https://ihthos.com/boundaries/): How scope, access, testing, human review, AI limits, documentation, and ownership are handled.
- [About](https://ihthos.com/about/): Background and working approach.
- [Contact](https://ihthos.com/contact/): How to start a conversation about a recurring task or handoff.
- [Guides](https://ihthos.com/guides/): Plain-language guides on automation patterns, readiness, cost, and custom software decisions.

## Guides

- [AI automation examples for small businesses](https://ihthos.com/guides/ai-automation-examples/): Six common patterns, what changes, and where a person stays involved.
- [Is your process ready to automate?](https://ihthos.com/guides/automation-readiness/): Seven questions to ask before automating, and the signs a process is not ready yet.
- [What affects the cost of an AI automation project](https://ihthos.com/guides/ai-automation-cost/): The factors that shape effort, and how to compare proposals.
- [Custom software or an existing tool?](https://ihthos.com/guides/custom-software-vs-off-the-shelf/): How to decide between a product, an integration, and a custom build.
- [Data entry automation for small businesses](https://ihthos.com/guides/data-entry-automation/): What copying work can be automated, which records still need a person, and what to fix first.
- [Lead follow-up automation for small businesses](https://ihthos.com/guides/lead-follow-up-automation/): What follow-up automation can carry, what should stay human, and how to design the handoff.
- [What is workflow integration?](https://ihthos.com/guides/workflow-integration-explained/): How systems exchange data, how integrations differ from automation and AI, and where they break.
- [Privacy](https://ihthos.com/privacy/): Privacy policy.
- [Terms](https://ihthos.com/terms/): Terms of use.

## Notes

- Contact: business@ihthos.com
